name: salesloft-webhooks-events
description: Verify and process Salesloft webhooks using exact raw-body SHA-1 HMAC, callback-token validation, event routing, durable deduplication, and reconciliation. Use when building or auditing a webhook receiver. Trigger with "Salesloft webhook", "Salesloft signature", or "Salesloft event handler".
